name: io.github.davidmosiah/ze-mcp
description: Unofficial local-first Zé Delivery MCP: catalog, search and order tracking. Place-order is fail-closed.

environmentVariables.name: ZE_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal Zé Delivery ticket. Prefer `ze-mcp-unofficial auth --token` so this never sits in client config.

environmentVariables.name: ZE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow place-order and cancel. Default false (never pays).

environmentVariables.name: ZE_PRIVACY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: summary | structured | raw. Default summary (redacts GPS/street/phone).
